title: Commit for "Close gatt when BLE is disconnected" deteriorates connection reliability
symptom: After a change to close GATT when BLE is disconnected, the app connects faster to the Pod but connection reliability has become a problem, with timeouts on connecting a few times a day.
cause: The change to close GATT when BLE is disconnected caused connection reliability issues.
fix: The problem was solved by commit 9c902fb141b8c784e1ac245fc35d3577113827d7.
